title: Present Perfect Basics
completion_message: ¡Excelente! El Present Perfect es el tiempo verbal más importante para hablar de experiencia profesional.

parts.visual:
Usamos el Present Perfect para hablar de acciones pasadas que tienen conexión con el presente (no importa CUÁNDO pasaron). 
Estructura: Sujeto + HAVE/HAS + Verbo en Participio.
parts.audio: We use the Present Perfect to talk about past actions that connect to the present. The exact time is not important. Structure: Subject, plus have or has, plus the verb in Past Participle.

parts.visual:
Ejemplos: I HAVE WORKED in marketing (He trabajado en marketing). 
She HAS FINISHED the report (Ella ha terminado el reporte). 
Preguntas de experiencia: HAVE YOU EVER...? (¿Alguna vez has...?). Ej: Have you ever managed a team?
parts.audio: Examples: I have worked in marketing. She has finished the report. To ask about life experiences, we use: Have you ever...? For example: Have you ever managed a team?

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta del Present Perfect (have/has + participio).

questions.question: I ____ worked in sales for three years. (He trabajado).
She ____ finished the presentation. (Ha terminado).
We have ____ a new supplier. (Encontrado - participio de find).
____ you ever managed a team? (¿Has...?).
He has ____ in London and Tokyo. (Vivido).
They ____ not signed the contract yet. (No han).
I have ____ that email three times! (Enviado - participio de send).
____ the CEO arrived? (¿Ha llegado...?).
questions.explanation: The CEO = He/She, por lo tanto 'Has'.

questions.question: I haven't ____ the boss yet. (Visto - participio de see).
We have ____ a lot of money on this project. (Gastado - participio de spend).
Have you ever ____ a mistake at work? (Cometido - participio de make).
questions.explanation: Participio de make = made (Make a mistake).

questions.question: Our company has ____ significantly this year. (Crecido - participio de grow).
I have ____ a new idea for the marketing campaign. (Tenido - participio de have).
questions.explanation: Present perfect del verbo have: I have had (Yo he tenido).

questions.question: The manager ____ approved the budget. (Ha aprobado).
Have they ____ to the client? (Hablado - participio de speak).
She hasn't ____ the email. (Leído - participio de read).
questions.explanation: Participio de read = read (se escribe igual, se pronuncia como el color rojo 'red').

questions.question: Have you ever ____ to New York on business? (Estado / Ido).
questions.explanation: Participio de be = been. Have you been to...? = ¿Has estado en...?

questions.question: We have ____ to cancel the meeting. (Decidido - participio regular).
I have ____ written the report. (Recién/Acabo de).
questions.explanation: Just + participio = acción que acaba de suceder.

questions.question: He has ____ in this company since 2015. (Trabajado).
questions.explanation: Present Perfect para acciones que empezaron en el pasado y continúan (He has worked).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe 'have' o 'has' y el verbo en participio.

questions.question: I ____ worked here for years. (He)
She ____ finished the report. (Ha)
____ you ever managed a team? (¿Has...?)
I have ____ the email. (Enviado - participio de send)
We have ____ a lot of money. (Gastado - participio de spend)
Have you ever ____ a mistake? (Cometido - participio de make)
He hasn't ____ the client. (Visto - participio de see)
Have you ever ____ to Paris? (Estado - participio de be)
The company has ____. (Crecido - participio de grow)
They haven't ____ to her. (Hablado - participio de speak)

I worked in sales for three years.
I am working in sales for three years.
